title: Finishing Head and Face Stroking
summary: Very light passes over the forehead, temples, and scalp gradually reduce intensity.
goal: Finish head and face work calmly.
startingPosition: The head is supported and the person relaxed.
instructions: Begin with a light forehead stroke.
direction: From the center of the forehead outward and then to the scalp.
warning: Do not massage damaged or inflamed skin. Stop with dizziness, worsening headache, pain, or other unusual symptoms.
